name: Glass no Destiny
source:
Main heroine Yuri enjoyed a happy childhood. Her father eventually remarries and two families start to live together while Yuri acquiring a new sister. But after Yuri's father death one by one disasters fall upon the family bringing it on the brink of despair.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.nl/2017/07/vn-of-month-september-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女主角本多由梨拥有一段幸福的童年。后来，父亲再婚，两个家庭开始共同生活，由梨也多了一名姐妹。然而，父亲去世后，灾难接二连三地落到这个家庭头上，把众人逼到了绝望边缘。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.nl/2017/07/vn-of-month-september-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
